item.title: Five years later...
item.description: It’s funny how many things seem important in life at the time, but in the long run turn out to not really matter at all. The last time I edited this blog was back in 2021, almost exactly five years ago. It doesn’t seem like that long ago but things in life were very different then. In 2021 I only had one child, both my parents were alive, and I was not as far along in my career as I am now.
